newsitem.title: USA: FTC wary of mergers in deregulated electric market.
newsitem.headline: FTC wary of mergers in deregulated electric market.

text.p: U.S. antitrust officials Wednesday urged lawmakers to ensure that all antitrust laws continued to apply to the electric industry if Congress orders states to open local power markets to competition.

"There will almost certainly be serious competitive problems that follow deregulation ... cartel behavior, mergers, monopoly behavior," Federal Trade Commission chairman Robert Pitofsky said at a House Judiciary Committee hearing on electric deregulation.
"The main message here is that antitrust should fully apply to this industry if and when it is deregulated," he said.
